messages:
oliver: Heads-up: nebula-streamline-v2 is GA on Hosted API today. It combines streaming, tool-calls, and a new fast-path scheduler. Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/hosted/nebula-streamline
maya: Nice! Any change to event schema for tool calls?
oliver: tool_call now includes tool_version and confidence fields. Streaming frames are still chunked-ld; clients should accept partial_event and final_event types.
dave: rollout plan?
oliver: canary starts 1792203600 at 3% traffic (us-east), 48h monitor; 25% week-1; full week-3. Hosted orgs auto-upgrade. Opt-out window 72h during canary via org settings.
ops-bot: provisioning canary cluster -> job 98765 initiated.
maya: example curl:
```curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"nebula-streamline-v2","input":"List next steps","enable_tool_calls":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/realtime/stream
```
qa-bot: NOTE: SDKs must handle tool_version in tool_call payloads; PRs opened: sdk-js #452, sdk-py #198.
oliver: Non-realtime endpoints unchanged. If you pin to the model name you'll get nebula behavior; runtime:latest will route to a compatible variant.
dave: ops, please watch p99 latency, stream error-rate, and tool-call failure rates in the canary window.
oliver: Thanks all — ping me for canary access or if you need a rollback flagged.
maya: congrats team! :tada:
